name: Interior Woodworks
old_description: Privately owned since 1994, Interior Woodworks uses old world techniques to design and fabricate signature pieces to ensure your cabinetry is unique and custom built.
about:
Interior Woodworks was founded in 1994 in Bismarck, North Dakota. The business has been privately owned since its start, and no individual founders are identified in the available information. The company began with a focus on custom woodwork using traditional methods.

Today, Interior Woodworks designs and fabricates signature pieces and custom cabinetry. The shop employs old-world woodworking techniques to ensure each piece is unique and built to order. The source does not provide figures for facility square footage, employee count, production volumes, or part-number catalogs.

The company’s customer base includes individuals and businesses looking for bespoke cabinetry and distinctive wood components. While the material does not name specific industries or client types, the nature of the work suggests service to residential, commercial, and possibly institutional projects.

The firm’s stated differentiation lies in its commitment to old-world craftsmanship as a means to deliver cabinetry that is both unique and custom built. This approach was the founding principle behind the company’s launch and continues to guide its operations.
